cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Anything but That Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to discuss the one detail that could expose your real motive or involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. This holiday photo would make a lovely anniversary card. Look at that sunset. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who's holding your hand at the edge?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Would you prefer the beach photo? More room for a message.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Same person, same bracelet. Who is it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That bracelet's exactly your colour. Shall I find you one for our anniversary?

mechanism: A directs making an anniversary card, shifts photos and then offers jewelry to keep B engaged while never naming the person holding A hand.
confusable: Unlike simply changing an aesthetic preference, every change avoids the same incriminating identity; authority gives B a role and offers a replacement gift.
comparison: An image trail and gift choice differ from a key provenance question redirected into dinner logistics.
seedUse: D134-b sunset, second photo and bracelet; S02-b changes the proposed medium to retain cooperation.
